roleZh: 保护内部组件并定位功率端子与信号针。
roleEn: Protects internal components and locates power terminals and signal pins.
featuresZh: 开口框架展示内部装配；真实密封、爬电距离与灌封需要独立设计。
featuresEn: An open frame reveals the assembly. Sealing, creepage and encapsulation require separate design.
materialZh: PPS 工程塑料；材料牌号与填充量视设计而定。
materialEn: PPS engineering polymer; grade and filler depend on the design.
